tasks.title: Bootstrap Python Project with uv
tasks.description: Initialize the Python project structure using uv, create pyproject.toml with all required dependencies (qdrant-client, fastembed, typer, rich, pymupdf, python-frontmatter), and set up the src/qdrant_indexer/ package structure.
tasks.details:
1. Run `uv init --app` to create basic project structure
2. Create pyproject.toml with:
   - Project metadata (name, version, description)
   - Python requirement >=3.10
   - Dependencies: qdrant-client>=1.12.0, fastembed>=0.6.0, typer>=0.12.0, rich>=13.0.0, pymupdf>=1.24.0, python-frontmatter>=1.0.0
   - Entry point: qdrant-indexer = "qdrant_indexer.cli:app"
   - Build system using hatchling
3. Create src/qdrant_indexer/ directory structure with __init__.py
4. Run `uv sync` to generate uv.lock and install dependencies

tasks.title: Implement Document Data Model
tasks.description: Create the core data structures for representing documents and their metadata in src/qdrant_indexer/models.py
tasks.details:
Create dataclasses/Pydantic models:
1. Document class with fields:
   - content: str (the text content)
   - metadata: dict (source file, frontmatter, etc.)
   - source_path: Path (original file path)
2. Chunk class with fields:
   - text: str (chunk content)
   - index: int (chunk position)
   - total_chunks: int
   - metadata: dict (inherited from document + chunk-specific)
3. IndexedPoint class representing a Qdrant point:
   - id: str/int
   - vector: list[float]
   - payload: dict

tasks.title: Implement Document Loaders
tasks.description: Create document loaders for different file formats in src/qdrant_indexer/loaders.py - supporting Markdown, Text, PDF, and ReStructuredText files.
tasks.details:
1. Create abstract base DocumentLoader class with load(path: Path) -> Document method
2. Implement MarkdownLoader:
   - Use python-frontmatter to extract YAML frontmatter as metadata
   - Return content without frontmatter
3. Implement TextLoader:
   - Simple file read with UTF-8 encoding
   - Basic metadata (filename, size, modified time)
4. Implement PDFLoader:
   - Use pymupdf (fitz) to extract text from PDF pages
   - Include page numbers in metadata
5. Implement ReStructuredTextLoader:
   - Parse .rst files
   - Extract directives/metadata if present
6. Create get_loader(file_path: Path) factory function
   - Map extensions to loaders: .md -> MarkdownLoader, .txt -> TextLoader, .pdf -> PDFLoader, .rst -> ReStructuredTextLoader
   - Default to TextLoader for unknown extensions
7. Create LOADERS dict for extension mapping

tasks.title: Implement Chunking Strategies
tasks.description: Create text chunking implementations in src/qdrant_indexer/chunkers.py with recursive character splitting as the primary strategy.
tasks.details:
1. Create abstract base Chunker class with chunk(text: str) -> List[str] method
2. Implement RecursiveChunker (primary strategy):
   - Parameters: chunk_size (default 512), overlap (default 50)
   - Split hierarchy: \n\n (paragraphs) -> \n (lines) -> . (sentences) -> space (words)
   - Ensure chunks don't exceed chunk_size
   - Maintain overlap between consecutive chunks for context continuity
3. Implement FixedSizeChunker (simple alternative):
   - Split text into fixed-size chunks with overlap
   - No semantic awareness
4. Create helper functions:
   - split_text_with_overlap(text, size, overlap)
   - merge_small_chunks(chunks, min_size)
5. Consider adding SemanticChunker placeholder for future enhancement

tasks.title: Implement Core Indexer
tasks.description: Create the main QdrantIndexer class in src/qdrant_indexer/indexer.py that orchestrates document loading, chunking, embedding, and uploading to Qdrant.
tasks.details:
1. Create QdrantIndexer class with:
   - __init__(qdrant_url, collection_name, embedding_model="sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
   - Initialize QdrantClient and FastEmbed TextEmbedding
2. Implement ensure_collection() method:
   - Check if collection exists with client.collection_exists()
   - Create with vectors_config: size=384 (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), distance=Cosine
3. Implement index_directory() method:
   - Parameters: path, pattern, chunker, batch_size
   - Glob files matching pattern
   - For each file: load with appropriate loader, chunk, embed, create points
   - Batch upload with client.upsert()
   - Include progress reporting
4. Implement index_file() method for single file indexing
5. Create point ID generation (hash of file path + chunk index)
6. Build payload with: text, source, chunk_index, total_chunks, timestamp, metadata

tasks.title: Implement CLI with Typer
tasks.description: Create the command-line interface in src/qdrant_indexer/cli.py using Typer with commands for indexing, listing, and deleting collections.
tasks.details:
1. Create Typer app instance
2. Implement 'index' command:
   - Arguments: path (directory to index)
   - Options: --collection, --url (default localhost:6333), --chunk-size, --chunk-overlap, --pattern, --batch-size, --exclude
   - Progress output with rich
3. Implement 'list-collections' command:
   - Option: --url
   - Display all collections with counts
4. Implement 'delete-collection' command:
   - Arguments: collection name
   - Options: --url, --yes/-y (skip confirmation)
   - Confirmation prompt using typer.confirm()
5. Implement 'reindex' command:
   - Delete existing collection data for source files, then re-index
6. Add rich console output for progress and status messages
7. Handle errors gracefully with helpful messages

tasks.title: Implement Configuration System
tasks.description: Create configuration handling in src/qdrant_indexer/config.py supporting both CLI arguments and optional .qdrant-indexer.toml config file.
tasks.details:
1. Define Config dataclass/Pydantic model with sections:
   - QdrantConfig: url
   - EmbeddingConfig: model, cache_dir
   - ChunkingConfig: strategy, chunk_size, chunk_overlap
   - IndexingConfig: batch_size, exclude_patterns
2. Implement load_config() function:
   - Search for .qdrant-indexer.toml in current dir and parents
   - Parse TOML file if found
   - Return default config if not found
3. Implement merge_config() to combine file config with CLI args
   - CLI args take precedence
4. Add config validation
5. Support environment variables for Qdrant URL (QDRANT_URL)

tasks.title: Create Nix Flake with uv2nix
tasks.description: Create flake.nix using uv2nix to package the application for Nix, providing both a package and development shell.
tasks.details:
1. Create flake.nix with inputs:
   - nixpkgs (nixos-unstable)
   - pyproject-nix
   - uv2nix
   - pyproject-build-systems
2. Configure outputs:
   - Load workspace with uv2nix.lib.workspace.loadWorkspace
   - Build Python set with dependencies
   - Apply overlays for wheel support
   - Create virtual environment with mkVirtualEnv
3. Define packages.${system}.default as the built package
4. Define devShells.${system}.default with:
   - The virtual environment
   - uv for development
   - Helpful shellHook message
5. Test with `nix build` and `nix develop`
6. Ensure fastembed model caching works correctly

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests for loaders, chunkers, and indexer components in tests/ directory.
tasks.details:

2. Create tests/ directory structure:
   - tests/__init__.py
   - tests/conftest.py (fixtures)
   - tests/test_loaders.py
   - tests/test_chunkers.py
   - tests/test_indexer.py
3. Test loaders:
   - Test each loader with sample files
   - Test metadata extraction
   - Test error handling for missing/invalid files
4. Test chunkers:
   - Test RecursiveChunker with various text sizes
   - Verify chunk sizes respect limits
   - Verify overlap is maintained
   - Test edge cases (empty text, text smaller than chunk_size)
5. Test indexer:
   - Mock Qdrant client for unit tests
   - Test collection creation
   - Test point generation
   - Test batch uploading logic
6. Create test fixtures with sample documents

tasks.details:

tasks.title: Implement File Filtering and Exclusion
tasks.description: Add support for glob patterns to include/exclude files during indexing, with sensible defaults.
tasks.details:
1. Add --pattern option for include patterns (default: "**/*.{md,rst,txt}")
2. Add --exclude option for exclude patterns
3. Default exclusions:
   - node_modules/**
   - **/.git/**
   - **/__pycache__/**
   - **/*.pyc
   - **/venv/**
   - **/.venv/**
4. Support multiple --exclude flags
5. Use pathlib and fnmatch for pattern matching
6. Respect .gitignore if present (optional enhancement)
7. Log which files are being skipped and why (in verbose mode)
